policy: A flag is not a blocker to publication; it is a blocker to trusting the affected number without reading it. Flags are closed only when a source exists.

items.title: No price has a published sampling time, so opening and closing cannot be distinguished
items.affects: price snapshots, CLV, line-move signals, demotion DM-1

items.title: The opening-number study covers one season and rests on an undocumented file
items.affects: any claim about how lines move
items.evidence: Only the 2021 early snapshot separates from a close (n=67 matched); its publisher does not document the columns or the sampling time.

items.title: The results snapshot is stale by at least one completed week
items.evidence: Feed frozen at 2026-11-01; the official Week 10 Thursday game is absent from it.

items.title: No historical player-prop prices exist, so prop combos cannot be tested
items.evidence: 0 priced prop bets across every registered prop family; the correlations are measured but unpriceable.

items.title: No official depth chart exists to cite
items.evidence: NFL.com's depth-chart path returns 404 and the official injury report carries no depth column.

items.title: Replacement depth cannot be measured in this build environment
items.evidence: Snap-count release assets are unreachable from the build sandbox (TLS reset); the CI workflow is the fix.

items.title: The prize pool is unfunded, so the reward tiers do not pay
items.evidence: prize_pool is null and status is UNFUNDED; no sponsor or currency appears anywhere in the repository.

items.title: No strategy clears the sample floor, so every family is untested rather than disproven
items.affects: any statement that a strategy 'does not work'
items.evidence: 5 of 12 fail DA-G2; the honest verdict is UNTESTED, which the gate reports separately from REJECTED.

items.title: Staking history covers 73% of spread legs and less of nothing else
items.evidence: 10,402 of 14,206 spread legs carry a price; unpriced legs are excluded rather than filled.

items.title: The official injury report is a point-in-time snapshot that changes before kickoff
items.affects: any injury feature used in a model
items.evidence: Statuses move between the Wednesday, Friday and Saturday reports; the capture time is not part of the official page.

items.title: The demotion rules have never fired
items.evidence: No strategy has ever been live, so no demotion transition has been exercised in operation.

items.title: No executable price, venue, limit or jurisdiction is held
items.affects: whether any positive-EV figure is actionable
items.evidence: No account, venue or stake limit is recorded anywhere; a positive expected value is therefore hypothetical.

items.title: Twelve open decision questions remain unanswered
Third-party redistributors are the only source for box scores and lines
items.affects: every correlation and every price on the site
items.evidence: The NFL publishes no machine-readable historical odds or box-score archive; nflverse redistributes it and is marked 3P on every page.

blanked_note: Counted from the built output: markets on the originated slate with no line or price, Week 9 games absent from the snapshot, and strategies with no measurable signal or staking value.
